They have submitted a request for a certificate of lawfulness to transform the structure, initially approved as a swimming-pool pavilion, into residential quarters. Although the summerhouse has served as guest accommodation for prior owners since 2012, the New Forest National Park Authority is currently assessing the appropriateness of their application.

The country also faces challenges managing surplus imported LNG despite household fuel shortages.
